title: Oklahoma National Guard aviation assists in combating wildfires
description:
Aircraft from the Army Aviation Support Facility 2 in Tulsa, Oklahoma assist Oklahoma Forestry Service in fighting a wildfire in Blaine County, Oklahoma, July, 2022. The Oklahoma National Guard supported the Oklahoma Forestry Services by providing areal firefighting using a UH-60 Black Hawk and LUH-72 Lakota. (Oklahoma Army National Guard video by Pfc. Haden Tolbert)

CG Information
Chief Warrant Officer 3 Ryan Johnson (00:16- 00:21)
Pilot, UH-60 Black Hawk 

Brian Ryles (00:26 - 00:30)
Forest Ranger, Oklahoma Forestry Service
